mapper.select:
SELECT (CASE WHEN ISDATE(OS.납기일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, OS.납기일자) , 126) ELSE OS.납기일자 END) AS OS_DEDT , OS.거래처코드 AS OS_BCNCCODE , ( SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.등록사업장 = OS.수주사업장 AND CM2.거래처코드 = OS.거래처코드) AS OS_BCNC , ( CASE WHEN LEN(OS.착지업체) < 1 THEN RTRIM(OS.거래처코드) ELSE RTRIM(OS.착지업체) END) AS OS_ENTRPSCODE , ( SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.등록사업장 = OS.수주사업장 AND CM2.거래처코드 = ( CASE WHEN LEN(OS.착지업체) < 1 THEN RTRIM(OS.거래처코드) ELSE RTRIM(OS.착지업체) END)) AS OS_DLVYENTRPS , OS.수주품목코드 AS OS_CODE , OS.수주단위 AS OS_UNIT , OS.수주수량KG AS OS_QUANTITY , OS.수주단가 AS OS_UNTPC , OS.수주금액 AS OS_SUMAMOUNT --부가세 포함한 합계 화면 표시 --, OS.착지비고 AS OS_NOTE , OS.비고 AS OS_NOTE , OS.등록일자 , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , SUM(OS.수주수량KG) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드, OS.착지업체) AS GRP_QUANTITYAM , SUM(OS.수주금액) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드, OS.착지업체) AS GRP_SUMAM , COUNT(OS.납기일자) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드, OS.착지업체) AS CO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드, OS.착지업체 ORDER BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드 DESC, OS.착지업체 DESC, RTRIM(IC.품목명)) AS GRP_DTNUMBER , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD, 5, #{listStartDt}),112) AS listStartDt
ORDER BY OS.납기일자, OS.거래처코드 DESC, OS.착지업체 DESC, RTRIM(IC.품목명)
mapper.sql: FROM 수주명세서 OS JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON ( OS.수주사업장 = IC.사업장 AND OS.수주품목코드 = IC.품목코드 ) JOIN 사업장코드 BPLC WITH(NOLOCK) ON(OS.수주사업장 = BPLC.사업장)
mapper.select:
SELECT (CASE WHEN WO.등록구분 = 'C' THEN '거래처' ELSE '관리자' END) AS W_REGISTSE , WO.단가사업장 AS W_UNIT_BPLC , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.접수일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.접수일자) , 126) ELSE WO.접수일자 END) AS W_RCEPTDE , WO.일련번호 AS W_SN , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.납기일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.납기일자) , 126) ELSE WO.납기일자 END) AS W_DEDT , WO.거래처코드 AS W_BCNCCODE , ( SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.등록사업장 = WO.단가사업장 AND CM2.거래처코드 = WO.거래처코드) AS CM_BCNC , WO.착지업체 AS W_ENTRPSCODE , (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WO.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WO.단가사업장) AS CM_DLVYENTRPS , WO.품목코드 AS W_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , WO.단가단위 AS UPC_NEWUNITPC
, WO.그룹수량 AS W_QUANTITY , WO.그룹수량 AS W_GRP_QY , WO.낱개수량 AS W_PIECE_QY , WO.중량 AS W_WT , WO.단가 AS W_UNTPC , WO.단가단위문자 AS W_UNIT_CHRCTR , WO.합계금액 AS W_SUMAMOUNT , WO.주문비고 AS W_NOTE , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , SUM(WO.수량) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드, WO.착지업체) AS GRP_QUANTITYAM , SUM(WO.합계금액) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드, WO.착지업체) AS GRP_SUMAM , COUNT(WO.납기일자) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드, WO.착지업체) AS CO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드, WO.착지업체 ORDER BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드 DESC, WO.착지업체 DESC, RTRIM(IC.품목명)) AS GRP_DTNUMBER , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD, 5, #{listStartDt}),112) AS listStartDt , DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), WO.납기일자) AS DATE_DIFF
, DBO.웹_재고중량_함수(WO.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목코드), 'C', WO.접수일자, WO.일련번호) AS INVNTRY_QY
ORDER BY WO.납기일자, WO.거래처코드 DESC, WO.착지업체 DESC, RTRIM(IC.품목명)
mapper.sql: FROM 웹주문접수 WO JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WO.단가사업장 = IC.사업장 AND WO.품목코드 = IC.품목코드) JOIN 사업장코드 BPLC WITH(NOLOCK) ON(WO.단가사업장 = BPLC.사업장)
mapper.select: SELECT 사.사업장 AS BPLC_CODE , ISNULL(MAX(일.수주최종번호),0) AS MAX_NUM , ISNULL(MAX(일.수주최종번호),0) AS CHG_NUM , (CASE WHEN ISNULL(MAX(일.수주최종번호),-1) < 0 THEN 'I' ELSE 'U' END) AS SE FROM 사업장코드 사 LEFT OUTER JOIN 일마감관리 일 WITH(NOLOCK) ON (일.사업장 = 사.사업장 AND 일.마감일자 = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112)) GROUP BY 사.사업장
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 일마감관리(사업장, 마감일자, 수주최종번호) VALUES(#{bplcCode}, CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112), #{chgNum});

update.foreach: INSERT INTO 수주명세서 ( 수주사업장 , 수주일자 , 수주일련번호 , 거래처코드 , 발주자 , 접수자 , 수주부서 , 주문구분 , 수주품목코드 , 수주단위 , 출고수량KG , 수주수량KG , 수주단가 , 수주금액 , 부가세금액 , 출하지시여부 , 출하완료여부 , 납기일자 , 비고 , 착지업체 , 착지비고 , 기준단가 , 등록자 , 등록일자 , 등록시간 , 생산지시 , 수주수량 , 웹접수일자 , 웹일련번호 ) SELECT WO.출고사업장 , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , #{item.osInsNo} , WO.거래처코드 , '' , #{bcncCode} , '' , '10' , WO.품목코드 , WO.단가단위문자 , 0 , WO.중량 , WO.단가 , WO.공급가액 , WO.부가세 , 'N' , 'N' , WO.납기일자 , '' , WO.착지업체 , LEFT(WO.주문비고,14) , WO.기준단가 , #{bcncCode} , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),108),':','') , 'N' , (CASE WHEN WO.단가단위 = 1 THEN WO.그룹수량 WHEN WO.단가단위 = 2 THEN WO.낱개수량 ELSE WO.중량 END) , WO.접수일자 , WO.일련번호 FROM 웹주문접수 WO WHERE 1=1 AND WO.접수확인 = 'N' AND WO.접수삭제 = 'N' AND WO.접수일자 = #{item.wRceptde} AND WO.일련번호 = #{item.wSn} ;
